_audit.CURRENT_GRADE: Grade C — T0 establishes baseline only

platforms.name: Royal Match
platforms.monetization_model: IAP-heavy (~98% revenue). Consumable IAPs $0.99–$19.99. Royal Pass subscription adds ~25% MRR. No ads. $1.4B revenue in 2024 (56% YoY growth). $3B lifetime since 2021. D2C webshop emerging.
top_user_complaints: Accidental IAP charges with no refund path
Later levels have steep difficulty spikes requiring purchases
Level content feels repetitive after extended play

platforms.name: Coin Master
platforms.monetization_model: Spin-based slot mechanic. IAP for spins and coins. $70M+/month IAP consistently since 2020. $553M IAP revenue in 2025 YTD. No advertising model — pure IAP. Social viral loops via Facebook raids/attacks.
top_user_complaints: Card duplication — rare cards nearly impossible to obtain
Won spins disappearing without support resolution
Heavy social pressure mechanics (raids/attacks on friends)

platforms.name: Monopoly GO
platforms.monetization_model: IAP $1.99–$99.99. $6B lifetime IAP in 2025 (fastest mobile game ever). D2C webshop (Scopely Store) with exclusive rewards and loyalty points. ~$1.3B in 2024. Heavy UA spend (~$500M). Hybrid ad+IAP.
top_user_complaints: Copy of Coin Master mechanics without originality

platforms.name: WOW Vegas
platforms.monetization_model: Sweepstakes dual-currency: Gold Coins (free play) + WOW Coins (sweepstakes redeemable). Free-to-play entry with optional Gold Coin purchases to accelerate play. 1500+ slot games. Revenue through Gold Coin sales.
top_user_complaints: Account locked at redemption stage after spending significant amounts
No live customer support — email only
Daily bonus considered insufficient relative to spend

platforms.name: LuckyLand Slots
platforms.monetization_model: Sweepstakes dual-currency: Gold Coins (fun play) + Sweeps Coins (redeemable). Gold Coin packages purchasable. Under severe regulatory pressure in 2025 — exited NJ, WV, DE, MS, CA, NV. Rebranding to LuckyLand Casino.
top_user_complaints: Sweeps Coin play removed in multiple states with little notice

platforms.name: PokerStars Social
platforms.monetization_model: Social casino / play-money model. IAP for play chips. Limited sweepstakes component. Revenue secondary to brand loyalty and cross-sell to real-money PokerStars platform. Social games target non-poker casual audience.
top_user_complaints: Limited game variety beyond poker variants
No meaningful sweepstakes / real prize redemption
